versions.changelog:
Initial release with streamlined, international focus and multi-platform support.

- Broadens supported platforms to Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, YouTube, LinkedIn
- Generates 10-20 alternative viral titles with CTR prediction scores and optimization suggestions
- Provides platform-specific guidance and viral title pattern analysis
- Simplifies content for an international audience; Chinese material and previous reference files removed
- Adds advanced parameters for audience, style, platform, and batch title count
- Removes in-repo reference material and sample scripts for a leaner release
